prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished LANDSCAPE two-panel architectural GAME CONCEPT image. This is a new design, NOT an edit of the reference. Reference image is ONLY candy-plastic material and game vocabulary; do not copy its abstract tower shapes. The new structure must clearly evoke a familiar real CITY BUILDING, with street-facing base, regular floor rhythm and a recognizable roofline. Simplified chunky toy-city architecture, smooth shiny candy plastic with gently bevelled edges, mint/turquoise/coral/cream/lavender palette, large substantial structural members and playable floor levels. NO photorealistic concrete, brick-by-brick walls, hundreds of little facade sticks, window curtain walls, furniture or unnecessary props. No sealed glass facade; many large unglazed openings and some broad wall-backed spaces. Keep designated climb ribs flat and uninterrupted, with floor edges and balconies recessed behind them; NO projecting floor lips across those ribs. Tower rests visibly on broad aligned supports. No floating disconnected floors or unsupported magical offsets. On ONE continuous island/paved-street setting with blue sky and ocean far in background, never little separated islands. RIGHT PANEL: a larger close view of a playable space in THIS SAME building, with consistent color and geometry. Visible stairs, floor openings over ascending flights and broad flat turn landings. Carefully drawn 3 small callout arrows across the two panels, pointing to actual features named below. Do not print measurements, FPS, object counts or structural-certification claims. Exact title: '11 Crownline Offices'. Exterior: A recognizable stepped early skyscraper reinterpreted in cherry-red floors, warm cream/mint structural piers and a lavender crown. Three distinct setback heights, broad open ground portico, oversized regular open window bays, no historical ornament or tiny windows. Right-panel space: Stand just outside the double-height ground lobby looking through its piers to a stair and daylight at the opposite street; show a cutaway corner above with several office floors, a recessed rest terrace and the straight unobstructed climb rib. Three exact labels: 'Open street lobby', 'Recessed climb rib', 'Multi-floor section'. Maintain city-building character and inviting open spaces; avoid abstract sci-fi sculpture.
